name: subservience
description: The feeling that your decisions and actions are directed by others, and that compliance is due to fear of negative consequences.
perceptions: I'm constrained in certain actions and decisions without agreement or by forced agreement.
There will be negative consequences if I don't comply.

guidance.description: If you feel uncomfortable forced into an action through coercive means, you should consider contacting reliable authorities in your area.

variations.name: slavery
variations.description: There is no escape and no agency -- you must obey the masters or face harsh consequences.
perceptions: I did not agree to this treatment.

variations.name: labor as punishment
variations.description: Being required to work as part of the consequences of breaking a social rule.
perceptions: I'm forced to do a particular action.
This is social punishment for something they think I did.
results: depends on how you view the justice of the situation

variations.name: submissive personality
variations.description: A sense that you would rather not make your own decisions, mostly letting others make them.
perceptions: I'm not forced to do what this person asks, but I don't want conflict or have nothing better to do.
I shouldn't make my own decisions because I'm not good at it or it might be unsafe.

guidance.description: Signs You Have a Submissive Personality and How To Stop It

commentaries.quote: Slavery and indentured servitude were unfortunately common in the distant past because civilization needed labor and didn't have the social or economic systems to encourage labor fairly. More humane social expectations have changed the world, as have labor-enhancing technologies.
Dependence begets subservience and paves the way for tyranny.
There's nothing wrong with being help. But it's very wrong that we presume people of colour are in a subservient position. That's problematic.
I think, especially growing up in the South, we are taught that women are supposed to be soft, gentle and kind of just goes along with everything and is submissive.
